<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Cancel a campaign run"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/run/{id}/cancel"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels a campaign run: a queued one is `CANCELLED` at once; for a running one a cancel is requested (`cancel_requested_at`), and its executor stops and finishes it as `CANCELLED` at its next heartbeat. 400 for an attack run (cancel its campaign run), 409 when the run already finished.
